nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Codex CLI JSONL session source, defining the codexapp- session id prefix and re-exporting the app.rs transcript parser.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Module root for the Cursor CLI (cursor-agent) session source, defining the cursorcliapp- session id prefix and re-exporting the per-session SQLite store reader.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Reads and normalizes Cursor CLI (cursor-agent) session history from per-session SQLite 'store.db' files, including a hand-rolled protobuf-like wire-format decoder and tool-call normalization for shell/edit operations.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a minimal varint/wire-format decoder (read_varint, wire_fields) to parse Cursor's binary blob columns without a full protobuf schema.

nodes.name: list_cursor_cli_history_sessions_paginated
nodes.summary: Lists cached Cursor CLI sessions in a paginated page for the sidebar.

nodes.name: list_cursor_cli_recent_paths
nodes.summary: Returns the most recently touched Cursor CLI session store paths for change detection.

nodes.name: load_cursor_cli_history_for_session
nodes.summary: Loads full history for a single Cursor CLI session id from its per-session store.

nodes.name: stat_cursor_cli_history_for_session
nodes.summary: Returns lightweight stat metadata (mtime/size) for a Cursor CLI session's store file without full parsing.

nodes.name: cursor_cli_history_candidate_paths
nodes.summary: Enumerates candidate on-disk store.db paths for all discovered Cursor CLI sessions.

nodes.name: sync_cursor_cli_history_cache
nodes.summary: Synchronizes the Cursor CLI session cache by discovering, parsing, and upserting all on-disk session records.

nodes.name: discover_cursor_cli_history_records
nodes.summary: Discovers all Cursor CLI session stores under the known sessions directory.

nodes.name: session_meta_from_store_conn
nodes.summary: Reads session metadata (title, model, timestamps) from an open Cursor CLI store SQLite connection.

nodes.name: session_meta_to_cache_input
nodes.summary: Converts parsed Cursor CLI session metadata into the cache input shape used by the imported-history cache layer.

nodes.name: first_user_prompt_from_chunks
nodes.summary: Extracts the first user-authored prompt text from a list of parsed activity chunks.

nodes.name: open_store_readonly
nodes.summary: Opens a Cursor CLI store.db SQLite file in read-only mode.

nodes.name: resolve_store_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the on-disk store.db path for a given Cursor CLI source session id.

nodes.name: stat_store
nodes.summary: Returns filesystem stat metadata for a Cursor CLI store.db file.

nodes.name: store_updated_at_ms
nodes.summary: Computes the last-updated timestamp in epoch milliseconds for a store.db file.

nodes.name: metadata_mtime_epoch_ms
nodes.summary: Converts filesystem metadata's modification time into epoch milliseconds.

nodes.name: read_store_meta
nodes.summary: Reads the top-level metadata row from a Cursor CLI store SQLite connection.

nodes.name: decode_meta_bytes
nodes.summary: Decodes the raw metadata blob bytes from a Cursor CLI store into structured fields.

nodes.name: read_blob
nodes.summary: Reads a single binary blob by id from the Cursor CLI store's blob table.

nodes.name: read_store_manifest
nodes.summary: Reads and decodes the root manifest blob that indexes a Cursor CLI session's message tree.

nodes.name: load_history_from_store_conn
nodes.summary: Loads and fully parses conversation history from an open Cursor CLI store connection into canonical activity chunks.

nodes.name: message_content_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the plain text content from a Cursor CLI message content value.

nodes.name: message_content_items
nodes.summary: Extracts the structured content items array from a Cursor CLI message content value.

nodes.name: clean_user_text
nodes.summary: Cleans and de-scaffolds raw user message text extracted from a Cursor CLI transcript.

nodes.name: strip_user_query_scaffold
nodes.summary: Strips Cursor's internal query-scaffolding wrapper text from a user message.

nodes.name: trim_wrapper_edges
nodes.summary: Trims leading/trailing wrapper markers from extracted message text.

nodes.name: split_think_blocks
nodes.summary: Splits reasoning/'think' blocks out of raw assistant message text.

nodes.name: tool_call_from_item
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical tool-call structure from a raw Cursor CLI message content item.

nodes.name: tool_result_output_text
nodes.summary: Extracts the textual output from a Cursor CLI tool result value.

nodes.name: normalize_cursor_tool_call
nodes.summary: Normalizes a raw Cursor CLI tool name and arguments into the app's canonical tool-call shape.

nodes.name: normalize_shell_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw shell tool call arguments into a canonical command/cwd structure.

nodes.name: normalize_edit_args
nodes.summary: Normalizes raw file-edit tool call arguments into canonical path/diff form.

nodes.name: cursor_cli_source_id_from_session_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the underlying Cursor CLI source session id from a canonical session id.

nodes.name: wire_fields
nodes.summary: Decodes a wire-format encoded byte buffer into a list of field number/value pairs.

nodes.name: read_varint
nodes.summary: Reads a single protobuf-style varint from a byte buffer at the given offset.

nodes.name: hex_encode
nodes.summary: Encodes a byte slice as a lowercase hexadecimal string.

nodes.name: hex_decode
nodes.summary: Decodes a hexadecimal string into a byte vector.

nodes.name: file_uri_to_path
nodes.summary: Converts a file:// URI into a plain filesystem path.

nodes.name: percent_decode
nodes.summary: Decodes percent-encoded (URL-escaped) characters in a string.

nodes.name: db.rs
nodes.summary: Scans the Cursor IDE global 'state.vscdb' and workspace conversation-index SQLite databases, builds cache inputs from raw composer data, and serves paginated/filtered session listings for the sidebar.

nodes.name: RawComposerData
nodes.summary: Raw deserialized shape of a Cursor IDE composer (chat session) row as stored in state.vscdb before normalization.

nodes.name: CursorSession
nodes.summary: Canonical Cursor IDE session summary combining cached metadata and derived fields, returned to the sidebar and session APIs.

nodes.name: get_cursor_sessions
nodes.summary: Returns Cursor IDE sessions filtered by an optional date range from the cache.

nodes.name: list_for_sidebar
nodes.summary: Returns a paginated page of Cursor IDE sessions for the sidebar listing.

nodes.name: get_cached_session
nodes.summary: Looks up a single cached Cursor IDE session by id.

nodes.name: list_for_sidebar_filtered
nodes.summary: Returns a paginated, filtered page of Cursor IDE sessions honoring an inclusion predicate.

nodes.name: delta_sync
nodes.summary: Performs an incremental sync of the Cursor IDE cache by discovering only changed sessions since the last run.

nodes.name: cached_cursor_child_ids_by_parent
nodes.summary: Builds a map of parent session id to child (continuation) session ids from the cache.

nodes.name: discover_from_index
nodes.summary: Discovers Cursor IDE session rows from the workspace conversation-index database.

nodes.name: build_inputs_from_index
nodes.summary: Builds a cache input record for a session discovered via the conversation index, enriching it with data from the main Cursor DB.

nodes.name: minimal_cache_input_from_index
nodes.summary: Builds a minimal cache input record directly from an index row when full composer data is unavailable.

nodes.name: load_composer_raw
nodes.summary: Loads the raw composer data blob for a given composer id from the Cursor IDE database.

nodes.name: cache_input_from_raw
nodes.summary: Converts raw composer data plus source metadata into a full cache input record.

nodes.name: cursor_last_active_at
nodes.summary: Computes the last-active timestamp for a Cursor IDE session from its raw composer data.

nodes.name: cursor_session_from_cached
nodes.summary: Builds a canonical CursorSession from a cached session row.

nodes.name: cursor_metadata_from_cached
nodes.summary: Extracts workspace/repo metadata from a cached Cursor IDE session row.

nodes.name: date_str_to_epoch_ms
nodes.summary: Parses a date string into epoch milliseconds at the start of day.

nodes.name: date_str_to_epoch_ms_end
nodes.summary: Parses a date string into epoch milliseconds at the end of day.

nodes.name: parse_iso_to_epoch_ms
nodes.summary: Parses an ISO-8601 timestamp string into epoch milliseconds.

nodes.name: disk_reads.rs
nodes.summary: Small helpers that read directly from Cursor IDE's application-support files on disk (model name list, composer last-updated timestamp) as a fallback to the SQLite store.

nodes.name: cursor_model_names_from_disk
nodes.summary: Reads the list of known Cursor model display names from the application's user blob file on disk.

nodes.name: cursor_composer_last_updated_at
nodes.summary: Reads a composer's last-updated timestamp directly from its on-disk workspace state file.
